protocol_type: Host-mastered byte-cycle protocol over 8-bit DQ. Each cycle is {Command (CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising → DQ=opcode), Address (CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising → DQ=address byte), Write Data (CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising → DQ=write byte), Read Data (CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n falling → device drives DQ=read byte)}.

cmd_format.address_cycles: Up to 5 (2 column + 3 row); column LSB shall be zero for NV-DDR family.
cmd_format.latching_edge_nv_ddr: Rising edge of CLK (cmd/addr); DQS edges (data)
cmd_format.latching_edge_nv_ddr2_3: Rising edge of WE_n (cmd/addr); DQS edges (data)

response_classes.name: Status byte
response_classes.content: {WP_n, RDY, ARDY, VSP, CSP, R, FAILC, FAIL}

response_classes.name: Feature data
response_classes.content: Get Features 4 P-bytes per feature address

response_classes.name: Page data
response_classes.content: Read / Read Cache burst on DQ

data_block_format.page_data_burst: Bytes streamed on DQ at host RE_n pulses (SDR) or RE/DQS edges (NV-DDR family).
data_block_format.write_data_burst: Host streams write bytes during data-cycle pulses (WE_n SDR / DQS NV-DDR).
data_block_format.tCCS_constraint: Host shall wait ≥ tCCS after second address byte of Change Read/Write Column before next data cycle.
data_block_format.data_burst_pause: Host may stop RE_n / DQS; ODT (if enabled) stays enabled; warmup not re-issued on resume.
data_block_format.data_burst_exit: Host raises CE_n, ALE, or CLE to one to exit data burst.

command_categories.opcodes: Read ID (90h), Read Parameter Page (ECh), Read Unique ID (EDh)
Read (00h/30h), Read Cache (00h/31h, 31h, 3Fh), Copyback Read (00h/35h), Change Read Column (05h/E0h, 06h/E0h)
Page Program (80h/10h), Page Cache Program (80h/15h), Copyback Program (85h/10h), Change Write Column (85h), Change Row Address (85h)
Multi-plane Read (00h/32h), Multi-plane Program (80h/11h), Multi-plane Erase (60h/D1h)
Set Features (EFh), Get Features (EEh), LUN Set/Get Features (D5h/D4h)
Implicit DCC (18h), Read DQ (62h), Write TX Pattern (63h), Write TX Readback (64h), Write RX (76h)

channels.name: WE_n
channels.description: Write Enable (SDR); shares pin with CLK on NV-DDR.

channels.name: RE_n / RE_t
channels.description: Read Enable (True); shares pin with W/R_n on NV-DDR.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: No per-byte VALID/READY on the wire — flow is regulated by host strobes (WE_n/RE_n/CLK/DQS) and device R/B_n.
R/B_n LOW indicates busy; host shall wait for R/B_n HIGH OR RDY=1 in Status before next command (except Read Status, Reset).
Multi-LUN: while R/B_n LOW, host may poll a specific LUN via Read Status Enhanced (78h + 3 row addr).
Read Status Enhanced shall NOT be used during/after Target-level commands.

frame_format.command_cycle: CLE=1, ALE=0, WE_n rising, DQ = opcode (8 bits).
frame_format.address_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=1, WE_n rising, DQ = address byte.
frame_format.write_data_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=0, WE_n rising (SDR) or DQS edge (NV-DDR family), DQ = write byte.
frame_format.read_data_cycle: CLE=0, ALE=0, RE_n falling (SDR) or RE_n_t/RE_n_c + DQS edges (NV-DDR family), DQ = device-driven read byte.
